Congress leader questions BJP's 'Har Ghar Tiranga' campaign symbolism

Congress leader Priyank Kharge questioned the Bharatiya Janata Party's (BJP) 'Har Ghar Tiranga' campaign, asking why the 'Bhagwa Dhwaj' (saffron flag) was being displayed over the national Tricolour. Kharge suggested that if the campaign is about patriotism, it should commence at the Rashtriya Swayamsevak Sangh (RSS) headquarters. The comments were made in relation to the 'Har Ghar Tiranga' initiative, which encourages citizens to hoist the national flag.
